evidence.snippet: In this paper, we present ContactWorld, a benchmark and systematic empirical study of vision-tactile world models spanning 12 contact-rich manipulation tasks, including insertion, disassembly, screwing, and exploratory interaction.

claire_radar.motivation: Contact-rich manipulation requires world models to reason over complex contact dynamics from multimodal sensory observations.
